# Kuailu HR | Industry Solutions

The PMF report identifies industries with fragmented shifts, mixed pay types and multi-site operations as the strongest planning fit. The following is a source-backed hypothesis, not a statement that every industry package is already delivered.

| Industry | Typical need | Relevant Kuailu HR capability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chain retail | Part-time shifts, multiple branches, variable staffing and mixed hourly / monthly pay | Multi-site attendance groups, scheduling, rolling-hours tracking and payroll linkage |
| Catering and food service | Split shifts, casual workers, high turnover and frequent payroll cycles | Shift scheduling, attendance rules, dynamic payroll and statutory calculation support |
| Hong Kong NGO / social services | Part-time or sessional workers, grant-funded cost centers and audit traceability | Employee lifecycle records, attendance evidence, payroll data and audit-oriented reports |
| Cleaning, property management and logistics | Multiple sites, frequent roster changes and 24-hour shifts | Site-based scheduling, cross-site allocation, attendance evidence and payroll integration |
| Mainland China HR operations | Employee, attendance and compensation management under the supplied V1.0 manual scope | Employee roster, attendance and compensation modules with configurable rules |
